blocks.noteGreen: Green = all 5 laps inside 26:00. Stretch = under 22:00. Log time, which chain broke first, RPE.
blocks.text: Lateral lunge: bells racked, step wide, sit into the working hip. Figure-8 to cossack: pass the bell under the leg, hold it at the chest, shift into the cossack on that side. Squat jump: knee-up, drop to a squat, jump.
